nextProject.title: Stocktwits

children.text: As the original creators of the “$cashtag”, Stocktwits has been a pioneer in blending social interaction and investing. We partnered with their team to create a reimagined identity that reflects the future of financial culture.

The financial industry is changing. Fast. And with over 10 million users, Stocktwits is the place that it's happening. But with a brand that looked better suited to the days when Facebook had walls and Twitter had normal human beings, it was time for an update.

We reimagined a brand built to reflect the pulse of the modern market and designed to resonate with the fast-moving, ever-evolving nature of today's investing culture. At the heart of the visual identity, the $cashtag, now contained within a speech bubble, frames Stocktwits as the ultimate space for connection, conversation, and community around finance.

The design system is unapologetic and modern, with bold typography and a vibrant colour palette that captures the intensity and energy of online financial communities. Infused with the same irreverent energy that turns market rallies into memes and trading losses into viral content, the identity commands attention whether it's breaking market news or dropping the hottest trading memes.

work.thumbnailExcerpt: Design & website design for Canada's largest online pharmacy.
work.title: Pocketpills

children.text: Canada’s largest online pharmacy needed a digital presence that could scale with its next big move: integrating telehealth alongside its pharmacy platform. Already trusted by thousands of Canadians each month, the goal was to create a unified, credible, and intuitive experience that made managing prescriptions and virtual care effortless.

(app UX) we delivered a brand refresh, website redesign, and motion design system. The direction was anchored in trust, convenience, and innovation, balancing the rigor of healthcare with the clarity and ease of a modern tech platform. We collaborated closely with their in-house development team to bring the design to life, optimizing for both customer confidence and conversion. The result is a scalable design system and digital experience that positions Pocketpills as more than a pharmacy, elevating it into a comprehensive healthcare platform built for the future.
